title: Burnout
description: A joke mod where torches "burnout" 0.1s after being placed!
body:
First official mod!

What does this do?

This jokey mod makes the new Weak Torches I've added "burnout" right after being placed, which means...
Eternal Darkness!

A few disclaimers:

I haven't tested this mod that much so comment about any bugs you see.

The mod only supports Fabric 1.21.8

Any requirements?

Yep. Like most Fabric mods, this one needs Fabric API 1.21.8 to run sucsessfully.

Enjoy!
